events.event: CNN Indonesia reports six regencies in East Java were hit by floods and landslides, and heavy rain triggered a Semeru lahar flood that inundated residential areas.

events.event: A concrete-mixer (molen) truck crash in Bekasi killed 6 people and the driver was named a suspect, per CNN Indonesia.
events.why_it_matters: Heavy-truck safety on Greater Jakarta roads affects every commuter.

events.event: CNN Indonesia reports a human-trafficking (TPPO) scheme recruiting Indonesians as Russian mercenaries with a promised bonus of Rp620 million; this follows Ukraine's FISU list of 8 WNI in the Russian army and Immigration profiling suspected recruiters.
events.key_numbers: Bonus Rp620 juta · 8 WNI on Ukrainian FISU list (27 Aug) · 7 of 8 got Russian visas in 2026
events.why_it_matters: Job-seekers lured by high-paying overseas offers can end up on a war front with passports taken.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional headline 2 Nov 20:50; story running since late Aug

events.event: Dozens of victims of a 'green investment' scheme reported it to police, with total losses of Rp5.7 billion.
events.key_numbers: Rp5,7 miliar total losses · dozens of victims
events.why_it_matters: Another investment-scam pattern that ordinary savers should recognize.

events.event: Depok mayor says the BisKita bus on the LRT Harjamukti route will no longer be free next year.
events.why_it_matters: Commuters in Depok will start paying for a feeder service they now ride free.

events.event: A fire at the Degayu landfill (TPA) in Pekalongan was being fought by crews on 2 November.
events.why_it_matters: Landfill fires bring smoke and a waste-management problem to nearby residents.
